run_pipeline_text_to_image: run the NucleusMoEImagePipeline to generate an image from a text prompt using 50 inference steps
encode_prompt_with_qwen3vl: encode a text prompt into embeddings using the Qwen3-VL text encoder via encode_prompt
calculate_shift_for_sequence: calculate the shift mu value for a given image sequence length using calculate_shift
retrieve_timesteps_from_scheduler: retrieve the timestep schedule from a FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler using retrieve_timesteps
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare random noisy latents packed into patch format for image generation using prepare_latents
